controls.network: task workspaces offline with prefetched Cargo dependencies and no remote
controls.stopping_rule: Stop before a case if worst-case estimated spend plus spent exceeds the cap. Keep every incomplete or failed case.

scoring.functional: hidden targeted test and broader regression test pass
scoring.task: functional passes with no forbidden path changes
scoring.strict: task passes without timeout or provider error and harness completes cleanly; Pactrail also requires ready-to-apply, source isolation, trace verification, and exact applied-candidate match

interpretation.supported: Whether this architecture branch fixes the previously measured no-edit failure on the known three-case regression under Space Bunny Alpha, and how it compares with OpenCode under that same model.
interpretation.not_supported: Broad coding-agent superiority or a held-out correctness claim; these tasks motivated the architecture.

revision_reason: The first pass-at-one trial failed before a model turn because OpenRouter repeated an identical tool_calls finish marker. Revision 508eaba accepts an exact repeat and retains contradictory or late-content rejection. All v1 outcomes remain published.
